title: Portfolio Allowance on a Settlement Where the Building Is Under Maintenance
content:
# Portfolio Allowance on a Settlement Where the Building Is Under Maintenance

An owner settling a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects at a building the company already maintains is allowed something off the figure, and the allowance is larger where the maintenance came first.

## Rule

Where an active Preventive Maintenance Agreement covers the building and it was signed before the project was awarded, the portfolio allowance is **1 per cent** of the figure settled.

Where an active Preventive Maintenance Agreement covers the building and it was signed after the project was awarded, the portfolio allowance is half of 1 per cent, that is **0.5 per cent**, of that figure.

Where no active maintenance agreement covers the building, no portfolio allowance is taken off: **0 per cent**.

## What is read

The agreement read is the one standing at the same building under the company's Preventive Maintenance Agreements, and what is read of it is its standing and the day it was signed, compared with the day the project was awarded. An agreement signed on the award day itself was not signed before it and takes the second case.

| Maintenance agreement at the building | Day it was signed against the award day | Portfolio allowance |
|---|---|---|
| active | earlier | 1 per cent |
| active | the same day | 0.5 per cent |
| active | later | 0.5 per cent |
| not active, or none at the building | — | none |

## Worked allowances (hypothetical figure of USD 90000 before the allowance)

An agreement signed a year before the award: USD 900.00 off, settling at USD 89100.00. An agreement signed two months after the award: USD 450.00 off. No active agreement at the building: nothing off.
